name: otto-hud
description: Otto, a blue octopus, forecasts your context window on one line above the prompt, in the Claude Code desktop app, and in text in the terminal: weather scaled to auto-compact with what fills the context on hover, the tokens each recent prompt added, and your 5-hour and 7-day limits with a pace projection. Labels in English or French. Fork of Anthropic's Token Weather (Apache-2.0).

language.title: Language
language.description: Labels in English (en) or French (fr). auto, or any other value, follows Claude Code's language setting, and falls back to English.
